title: B8.4 synthetic submission (PROVISIONAL)
description: One fictional submission: repository + demo link + short report (PRD B8). The fields are format-neutral on purpose: how they are placed in Moodle online text or files is the submission-content rule, which is not decided (design Q32).

repository_url.description: Placeholder on a reserved .invalid host (RFC 2606); replaced by the lab git server address when the set is published.

demo_url.description: Placeholder on a reserved .invalid host; replaced by a lab stub page when the set is published.

hosting.description: What the (future) publish step must set up so the machine checks give the intended result.

publish_repo.description: false: the repository is not published, so the URL does not clone.

demo_stub.description: answers: a stub page that answers the test question; unrelated_page: returns HTTP 200 with unrelated content; none: nothing is served.
